items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: when Sweet Pea -- Billy Strayhorn? Billy, uh-huh, with Duke, he would make that his home. And then he'd get drunk we'd put him under the piano and let him sleep it off

ctx.x: Right, right, see. We got to hear everybody, because that was the meeting place. And God bless the dead, when Sweet Pea --
